titre: Transferts de risques de retraite au Royaume-Uni
sous_titre: Nombre d'opérations réalisées dans l'année, 2023 à 2025

2023.texte: an increase of one third from the previous record of 226 buy-ins completed in 2023

2024.texte: 299 defined benefit (DB) pension scheme buy-ins were completed in 2024

2025.texte: In 2025, a record 370 buy-ins took place, covering £38bn of premium.
